summary: The final testing strategy covers every load-bearing behavior with an appropriate test type and meaningful state/output assertions. The watcher CLI is exercised through its real stdin/stdout boundary, the exact 1 MiB and plus-one-byte cases pin the reader limit, scheduler timelines use real temporary SQLite and assert exact row movement, and mixed-queue plus cross-day behavior protect the planned/execution split. The unit/integration pyramid is healthy and live E2E remains correctly excluded for the production-only channel.
